full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a young woman standing in a grassy open field among a close flock of white sheep. She stands almost at the center of the frame, full length, facing the camera with her hands loosely joined in front of her. Her pale yellow knee-length dress has a small allover pattern and short white sleeves; white socks and dark shoes are visible below its hem. Reddish brown hair frames her face, which looks directly outward with a reserved, solemn expression. Sheep crowd on both sides and behind her, their woolly heads at about waist height. Several in the front look toward the viewer, making a dense, softly textured ring around her still figure. The field slopes into low green hills, with a dark horizon beneath a large gray overcast sky. A small red vehicle sits far back on the right near the horizon, adding an isolated color accent and a sense of scale. There are no dramatic gestures or arranged props. The slightly low camera height places the viewer close to the animals while still preserving the full figure and the broad landscape. Cloud-filtered daylight is cool and even, with gentle shadows under the sheep and folds of the dress. Muted greens, off-white wool, dull yellow cloth, and gray sky dominate. The image feels candid yet strangely composed, joining ordinary rural detail with the stillness and tension of a story whose context remains unseen.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一名年轻女子站在开阔草地里，周围紧挨着一群白羊。她几乎位于画面中央，全身入镜，面向相机，双手松松相扣置于身前。浅黄及膝连衣裙布满细小纹样，配短白袖；裙摆下露出白袜和深色鞋。红褐头发围住脸，她以克制而肃静的神情直视前方。羊群从两侧及身后围拢，蓬松的头部大约齐腰高。前方几只羊也看向观者，在她静止的身影周围形成密集而柔软的纹理圈。草地向低矮绿丘延伸，深色地平线上压着大片灰色阴天。远处右侧地平线附近有一辆小红车，成为孤立的色点并提示尺度。画面没有戏剧性动作或刻意安排的道具。略低的机位使观者接近羊群，同时保留完整人物和宽阔风景。云层滤过的日光冷而均匀，羊身下方和裙褶中只有轻微阴影。灰绿、米白羊毛、暗黄布料与灰天占主导。照片既像偶遇，又有奇异的构图感，把日常乡村细节与上下文未明的故事静止感合在一起。
style_prompt_en: A restrained color photographic language places a sharply readable central form within a broad, ordinary outdoor environment. Soft overcast illumination makes tonal transitions even, with little specular shine and no theatrical spotlight. Muted yellow, green, off-white, and gray are held at low saturation; one small warm accent in the far distance punctuates the palette. Repeated pale textures gather around a quiet center, forming visual density without losing the larger horizon and sky. Detail remains natural and slightly imperfect, while framing gives everyday surroundings a measured, almost enigmatic order. Depth is built through a near cluster, a clear middle distance, and subdued rolling ground under an expansive cloud layer. The finished image has documentary credibility, tender surface texture, and an understated narrative unease produced by stillness, scale, and carefully balanced space.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的彩色摄影语言把清晰可读的中央形体放进宽阔平常的室外环境。柔和阴天光令明暗过渡均匀，少有镜面亮斑，也无戏剧化聚光。低饱和的黄、绿、米白与灰保持节制；远处一枚小小暖色点轻触色板。重复的浅色纹理围拢安静中心，形成视觉密度，却不吞没更远的地平线与天空。细节自然且略有不完美，取景却使日常环境显出有分寸、近乎神秘的秩序。近处密集层、中景清晰层与广阔云层下的低缓远地共同建立深度。成品具有纪实可信度、柔软表面纹理，以及由静止、尺度和均衡空间产生的含蓄叙事不安。

name: Alessandra Sanguinetti
